scope: Same module packed14/15 native fullK864 R8 -> exact rawp -> real IEEE FP32 identity -> J20 -> I24; complete 19200tile frame

producer_common.source: 1536x10bit SRAM, one word/allow; same160bit C1 window with4 local10bit read muxes
producer_common.latent: 8banks x20rows x26bits=520B; 208bit vector read/write, onebank26bit scalar read; same for14/15
producer_common.psum: 8x480xsigned32=15360B; every complete output stored once, then drain-read once; OS8x32 accumulator registers
producer_common.support: 40x8 finalposition mask plus8rank support; Q2v_live96 computed at config
producer_common.arithmetic: 8 signed19x13 multipliers,8x32dataaddchains; bit13carry disabled only in ZADD; no carry split in fullpsum MAC
producer_common.configuration: Q1 864 + Q2 96 + k_live864 =1824beats, then consumer24 =1848 shared256bit beats; no expanded/mask inputs
producer_common.not_area_equivalent_previous: Different208bit z/vector and26bit scalar interface,19x13multiplier andcachedOS; do not present comparisons with previous9/11 as samearea

consumer_contract.J: RTL reads IEEE binary32 identity bits; CONVERT_IDENTITY executes signed32 saturate(RNE(identity*2^20)) in one paid vector cycle
consumer_contract.wide: signed64 p*a + (b+J)*2^20; performed MUL, ADD_BIAS, ADD_IDENTITY in separate states
consumer_contract.I24: signed24 saturate(RNE(wide / 2^26)); negative ties use floor quotient and positive remainder
consumer_contract.same_function: Modes6/7/9/11 exactly same fixed deployment function. New quantized affine/J function is not bit-identical to prior FP32 BN/add. No z/p intermediate RNE.

consumer_common_resources.rounding: 8 signed64-to-signed24 RNE/saturation units, including rounding increment/comparison logic
consumer_common_resources.coefficient_memory: 8 x 24 x signed32 = 768 bytes; ONE 256-bit common-row read, separate a then b reads; 24 vector reads per tile
consumer_common_resources.buffers: p/J/a/b each 8x32 bits, one 8x64 accumulator, one 8x32 output = 224 bytes; no full identity/output array in consumer
consumer_common_resources.coefficient_reuse: a/b hold reused across all 40 P/T rows in each N8 group; same reuse for every producer mode
consumer_common_resources.raw_interface: 8x32 ready/valid, single-entry; address checked against expected row
consumer_common_resources.identity_interface: Independent 8x32 IEEE binary32 raw-bit ready/valid, single-entry; actual tile+row address request, stalls paid. Finite input domain; exponent/significand shift, guard/remainder parity, saturation. NaN/Inf set error.
consumer_common_resources.output: 8 signed24 I24 sign-extended in a 256-bit transport vector; tile, row, tile_last and job_last
consumer_common_resources.diagnostics: 15 x 32-bit consumer counters; diagnostic raw/J outputs are observation-only and do not supply execution values
consumer_common_resources.not_free_widening: These eight wider multipliers and adders are ADDED shared backend resources, not the old 16x13 multipliers relabeled as 32x32
consumer_common_resources.conversion_storage: The same 8x32 identity register first holds FP32 bits then J20, no duplicate vector storage; conversion monitor is combinational diagnostic only

stream_common_resources.diagnostics: Wrapper 64-bit time/transaction counters, retired_tiles32; producer and consumer diagnostic counters instantiated. Exact declarations remain in SV.
stream_common_resources.source_buffer: one tile in existing producer source memory; no double buffer or source/compute overlap
stream_common_resources.parameter_port: 256bit one address/beat, only4Q1,5Q2,6k_live,7a/b:1848staticbeats once. Newsource/origin/identity everytile.
stream_common_resources.new_tile: 1536 source writes (10 useful bits per source response, padded words generated in RTL) plus 1 origin config beat
stream_common_resources.identity_per_tile: 480 actual 256-bit IEEE FP32 requests, 15360 bytes; no halo identity reread; conversion and new I24 gold both independently checked
stream_common_resources.source_geometry: Absolute C*76800+Y*320+X address calculated in RTL; output tile 2x2, input origin output-1; source array [96,240,320]
stream_common_resources.retirement: Requires producer done AND all480 consumer results accepted and consumer done; no next tile before last consumer
stream_common_resources.memory_model: Elastic immediate-response local interfaces with arbitrary tested backpressure; no external DDR latency, cache or SRAM macro mapping

cycle_accounting.consumer_active_per_tile: 3385 + join_wait_cycles + consumer_output_stalls; includes 480 actual FP32-to-J20 vector conversions
cycle_accounting.job_total: sum(consumer_cycles) + static_words + parameter_stalls + source_load_words + origin_words + source_load_stalls + 2*tiles + 1
cycle_accounting.warning: Producer and consumer cycle counters overlap; never add them as serial jobs. Internal producer output stalls include the real consumer service. Cold static loading is paid once, warm commands reload source/origin/identity.
cycle_accounting.producer_base: 5437*tiles + liveK + 2*activeK + 3*first_issues + second_MAC; then add source/weight/output stalls
cycle_accounting.paired_difference: No-stall mode14_total-mode15_total = 3 * real double-active(P0,P1 or P2,P3 at sameT,K) count; all consumer and secondstage work equal

not_measured: r1 As/threshold/PED and downstream whole-network RTL
